decisions.defaultGeometry: Power-two Helmholtz shaping remains the accuracy-first default. Power one is retained as an explicit speed ablation until synthetic recovery and cohort accuracy justify changing the geometry.
decisions.galeBoundary: No Gale source change. ScalaFIM supplies the physical masked Helmholtz operator and precomputed Jacobi diagonal; Gale supplies the general reusable CgWorkspace, cgWith recurrence, relative tolerance, initial guess, and preconditioner capability.
decisions.mapLifetime: Rejected attempts reuse one caller-owned four-map midpoint destination. Accepted state and candidate destinations are ping-ponged lazily, so exact rollback does not allocate new dense maps on every retry.
decisions.pyramidLifetime: Fixed and moving pyramids share one source-sized scratch workspace. An unsmoothed shrink-one level aliases the original source instead of copying it, and a state already on the requested frames is not regridded.
decisions.workspaceAliasing: The engine shares feature and topology scratch sequentially and writes the Sobolev result over the consumed raw LM step. A dedicated oracle proves aliased and disjoint Sobolev destinations agree.

environment.contentionNote: Unrelated local development servers and agent processes were present. No ANTs, Docker benchmark, or second HalfFlow JMH process was run concurrently.

numericalAdmission.engine: Identity is stationary; a smooth two-level 0.35 mm fixture accepts at least one step, lowers the objective, recovers a positive fixed-to-moving displacement, and passes the accumulated topology guard; impossible gain acceptance rejects exactly without changing the selected maps.
numericalAdmission.objective: Candidate energy is evaluated on the fixed current support with the current robust scale. Missing candidate support is a typed rejection rather than a support-changing objective.
numericalAdmission.sobolev: The masked no-flux operator matches an independent stencil; power-two shaping matches the discrete Neumann cosine response; masks and physical displacement/strain caps are exact; aliased LM storage matches disjoint output.
numericalAdmission.topology: Local and accumulated inverse-pair guards remain mandatory before candidate evaluation and acceptance.
